messages.subject: Problem using "EAPsum" in fscores
parts:
Hi Phil,

When trying to apply the fscores function using the EAPsum method, I run into the following error. 

> thetas.EAP <- fscores(grm1,method="EAPsum",response.pattern=dat.lw,full.scores=T,full.scores.SE=T,theta_lim=c(-4,4))
Error in t(t(dat) - adj) : 
  dims [product 25569] do not match the length of object [0]

I found the source of the error to be the following lines from the internal EAPsum function (https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt/blob/master/R/fscores.internal.R). 

dat <- x@Data$data
adj <- x@Data$min
dat <- t(t(dat) - adj)

When applying this manually to the model (grm1), I notice that grm1@Data$min is not a valid option, but grm1@Data$mins (with an s behind it) is. When I manually calculate "dat" like this, using mins instead of mins, there is no problem. 

Do you also think this is the issue, and if so, can I fix it somehow? If this is not the problem, do you know what is?

Thanks in advance,
Eva

messages.subject: Re: Problem using "EAPsum" in fscores
parts:
Interesting. Could you open an issue on Github so we can try and fix it there? Providing a brief reproducible example is also important. The issue seems to be older code which should be replaced with the extract.mirt() function to properly extract variables. Cheers.

Phil
